description: Calculates where the nine Vedic planets are right now in the sidereal zodiac (Lahiri): each planet's sign, degree, nakshatra and pada, whether it is retrograde, and when it next changes sign. Use it when someone asks where a planet is today, which planets are retrograde, or when a planet changes sign. Needs no birth details. Returns positions and dates only, with no interpretation.

time_zone.description: Optional. IANA time zone for the dates shown, for example "Asia/Kolkata". Defaults to UTC.

name: get_planet_positions
title: Get current planet positions
